a5439:
# waiting-on-me: what waits on Alex's review, in the home base (a5390). Every thing tagged ready-for-review is listed,
# and every design waiting on his word (design=waiting: a document can't take a tag; Sable, c5554), a dynamic list
# with no records of its own; one marked Later (review=later on it) goes below the rest. A click on one opens it in
# place (a5504): its words, and its demo when it names one (demo=<lens> on the thing paints that lens inside the card);
# a second click folds it. Seen / Done takes the tag off (a design's state is Alex's to set in its own talk, so it has
# none), Later marks it, Open fully shows the whole of it, Open here shows it in the middle (the viewer, a5398).
# What is open is the viewer's own note (role=home-review, actor=$me): reviewing= the thing, full=yes when shown whole.
# a5504: an act that replaces a prop of a note reads it in its own part (in a `when`, a let or its words). A press is
# fenced on what its part read; full=no, never painted, refused every click as 'you have not seen a5441's prop:full'.
waiting : column
  let now = count(tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later)
  let later = count(tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later)
  none : text "Nothing waits on you."
    role meta
    only when now + later = 0
  mine : column
    of prop:role=home-review,prop:actor=$me as rd
    each desk
  lost : text "No review note for you here (role=home-review, actor=you), so a click has nowhere to open."
    role hint
    only when count(prop:role=home-review,prop:actor=$me) = 0
desk : column
  role waitdesk
  now : column
    role waitlist
    of tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later as w
    each item
  designs : column
    role waitlist
    of prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later as w
    each item
  laterhead : text "LATER"
    role lanename
    only when later > 0
  later : column
    role waitlist
    of tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later as w
    each item
  laterdesigns : column
    role waitlist
    of prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later as w
    each item
item : column
  role wait
  role wait.on when $item = $rd.reviewing
  let days = ($today - date($changed.tags)) / 1d
  head : column
    role waithit
    on click when $item != ($rd.reviewing or "") and $rd.full = "yes" do prop $rd reviewing=$w full=no
    on click when $item != ($rd.reviewing or "") and ($rd.full or "") != "yes" do prop $rd reviewing=$w
    on click when $item = $rd.reviewing and $rd.full = "yes" do prop $rd reviewing="" full=no
    on click when $item = $rd.reviewing and ($rd.full or "") != "yes" do prop $rd reviewing=""
    title : text "$title"
      role who
      clamp 2
    facts : row
      role waitfacts
      kind : text "$kind"
        role tag
        only when ($design or "") != "waiting"
      design : text "design"
        role tag.design
        only when $design = "waiting"
      by : text "by $by"
        role meta
        only when $design = "waiting" and ($by or "") != ""
      demo : text "demo inside"
        role tag.demo
        only when ($demo or "") != ""
      today : text "today, $(time($changed.tags))"
        role meta
        only when ($design or "") != "waiting" and days < 1
      yday : text "yesterday"
        role meta
        only when ($design or "") != "waiting" and days = 1
      ago : text "$(days) days ago"
        role meta
        only when ($design or "") != "waiting" and days > 1
  open : column
    role reviewbody
    only when $item = $rd.reviewing
    short : text "$text"
      role prose
      marks
      clamp 5
      only when ($rd.full or "") != "yes" and ($text or "") != ""
    whole : text "$text"
      role prose
      marks
      only when $rd.full = "yes" and ($text or "") != ""
    adesign : text "A design waiting on your word. Open here reads it as its blocks; you answer in its own talk."
      role meta
      only when $design = "waiting"
    show : column
      role demo
      only when ($demo or "") != ""
      lens $w.demo
    acts : row
      role reviewacts
      done : text "Seen / Done"
        role button
        only when ($design or "") != "waiting"
        on click when ($review or "") = "later" and $rd.full = "yes" do tag $item remove=ready-for-review; do prop $item remove=review; do prop $rd reviewing="" full=no
        on click when ($review or "") = "later" and ($rd.full or "") != "yes" do tag $item remove=ready-for-review; do prop $item remove=review; do prop $rd reviewing=""
        on click when ($review or "") != "later" and $rd.full = "yes" do tag $item remove=ready-for-review; do prop $rd reviewing="" full=no
        on click when ($review or "") != "later" and ($rd.full or "") != "yes" do tag $item remove=ready-for-review; do prop $rd reviewing=""
      here : row
        of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me as hv
        each openhere
      later : text "Later"
        role chip
        only when ($review or "") != "later"
        on click when $rd.full = "yes" do prop $item review=later; do prop $rd reviewing="" full=no
        on click when ($rd.full or "") != "yes" do prop $item review=later; do prop $rd reviewing=""
      back : text "Not later"
        role chip
        only when $review = "later"
        on click do prop $item remove=review
      more : text "Open fully"
        role chip
        only when ($rd.full or "") != "yes" and ($text or "") != ""
        on click do prop $rd full=yes
      less : text "Show less"
        role chip
        only when $rd.full = "yes"
        on click do prop $rd full=no
      gap : text ""
        share 1
# the viewer (a5398) opens the thing in the middle; Back there returns to what it showed before. `was` reads back=
# so the press may replace it
openhere : text "Open here"
  role chip
  let was = $hv.back
  on click when ($hv.find or "") != "" do prop $hv viewing=$w back="$hv.viewing" find=""
  on click when ($hv.find or "") = "" do prop $hv viewing=$w back="$hv.viewing"
a5548:
# home-board: the board, one panel of the home base (a5674). The HUD sprint's lane 1, round 3 (a6010): an inbox. NEEDS
# YOU (what waits on Alex: things to look at, designs waiting on his word, his own stuck commissions; it answers what
# waiting-on-me did), IN MOTION, LANDED, one line per card. A line says what it is (brief= when the card has one, else
# its title), how far along (a word at the right edge, and since when) and, on a line that needs Alex, its answer: one
# press, never typing (Looks good, Send back, Later; Build it on a design; Try again). Colour says whose move it is
# (LAMPLIT, lane 3): amber Alex's, lilac a resident's (what waits on JEFF folds into one line), mint an agent at work
# this moment; the rest grey, buttons white. A press anywhere else on a line opens it in place at once (the viewer's own
# fold): its track, who has it (names, never ids), its worker's latest word, Open in the middle, where its talk is
# (one box for words, the middle's; agreed with lane 3 in a6049). Roles: the nb* block in home-style.
board : column
  role nb
  views : column
    of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me as hv
    each bands
  lost : text "No viewer note for you here (role=home-view, actor=you): Open has nowhere to show a card."
    role hint
    only when count(prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me) = 0
bands : column
  role nbbands
  let nneed = count(tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,-prop:review=later)
  let nlater = count(tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later) + count(prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,prop:review=later)
  let nmove = count(prop:commission=asked) + count(prop:commission=working) + count(prop:commission=ready) + count(prop:commission=landing) + count(prop:commission=waiting,prop:waiting_on)
  let njeff = count(prop:commission=waiting,-prop:waiting_on) + count(prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by!=alex)
  let nlanded = count(prop:commission=landed)
  let busy = count(house doing=working)
  need : column
    role nbband
    head : row
      role nbhead
      name : text "NEEDS YOU"
        role nbname.need
      n : text "$(nneed)"
        role nbcount.need
        only when nneed > 0
      gap : text ""
        share 1
      none : text "nothing waits on you"
        role nbquiet
        only when nneed = 0
    reviews : column
      role nbcards
      of tag:ready-for-review,-prop:review=later as c
      each review
    designs : column
      role nbcards
      of prop:design=waiting,-prop:review=later as c
      each design
    failed : column
      role nbcards
      of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,-prop:review=later as c
      each failure
    later : column
      role nblater
      only when nlater > 0
      fold "Later · $(nlater)" handle nbfold
      a : column
        role nbcards
        of tag:ready-for-review,prop:review=later as c
        each review
      b : column
        role nbcards
        of prop:design=waiting,prop:review=later as c
        each design
      f : column
        role nbcards
        of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by=alex,prop:review=later as c
        each failure
  move : column
    role nbband
    head : row
      role nbhead
      name : text "IN MOTION"
        role nbname
      n : text "$(nmove)"
        role nbcount
      gap : text ""
        share 1
      live : text "$(busy) at work now"
        role nblive
        only when busy > 0
    landing : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=landing as c
      each moving
    ready : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=ready as c
      each moving
    working : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=working as c
      each moving
    queued : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=asked as c
      each moving
    dependencies : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=waiting,prop:waiting_on as c
      each moving
    jeff : column
      role nbjeff
      only when njeff > 0
      fold "WAITING ON JEFF · $(njeff)" handle nbfold.jeff
      asking : column
        role nbrows
        of prop:commission=waiting,-prop:waiting_on as c
        each moving
      stuck : column
        role nbrows
        of prop:commission=failed,prop:asked_by!=alex as c
        each moving
  landed : column
    role nbband
    fold "LANDED · $(nlanded)" handle nbfold
    rows : column
      role nbrows
      of prop:commission=landed as c
      each done
# a thing waiting on Alex's look: a note, a demo, a report (tagged ready-for-review)
review : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    ok : text "Looks good"
      role nbgo
      on click do tag $c remove=ready-for-review; do comment $c line="@jeff: looks good (from the board)"
    no : text "Send back"
      role nbaway
      on click do tag $c remove=ready-for-review; do comment $c line="@jeff: not yet: send this back (from the board)"
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
    back : text "Now"
      role nbaway
      only when $c.review = "later"
      on click do prop $c remove=review
  body : column
    role nbbody
    facts : row
      role nbtop
      kind : text "to look at"
        role nbwhen
      demo : text "· a demo inside"
        role nbwhen
        only when ($c.demo or "") != ""
      when : text "· waiting since $(day-or-time($changed.tags, $today))"
        role nbwhen
        only when ($changed.tags or "") != ""
    gist : text "$c.text"
      role nbgist
      clamp 4
      only when ($c.text or "") != ""
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# a design waiting on Alex's word: Build it is his word in one press (design=answered verdict=build, and a line in its
# own talk, which reaches its author); Later puts it off; Read it opens it in the middle
design : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    build : text "Build it"
      role nbgo
      on click when $c.design = "waiting" and ($c.talk or "") != "" do prop $c design=answered verdict=build; do append $c.talk line="Build it. (from the board)"
      on click when $c.design = "waiting" and ($c.talk or "") = "" do prop $c design=answered verdict=build; do comment $c line="@jeff: build it (from the board)"
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
    back : text "Now"
      role nbaway
      only when $c.review = "later"
      on click do prop $c remove=review
  body : column
    role nbbody
    by : text "a design by $(($c.by or "someone")), waiting on your word"
      role nbwhen
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      read : text "Read it in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# a commission Alex asked for that did not land and its worker could not mend: Try again starts its worker once more
failure : column
  role nbneed
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    again : text "Try again"
      role nbgo
      on click when $c.commission = "failed" do prop $c commission=asked
    later : text "Later"
      role nbaway
      only when ($c.review or "") != "later"
      on click do prop $c review=later
  body : column
    role nbbody
    who : text "did not land; its worker could not mend it"
      role nbwhen
    last : column
      of comments:$c.item as m
      each note
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# one commission on its way: what, then at the right edge how far and since when; pressed, who has it and their word
moving : column
  role nbrow
  fold inline group open handle nbchev
  line : row
    peek
    role nbline
    what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
      role nbrowtitle
      clamp 1
      share 1
    queued : text "queued"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "asked"
    live : text "working"
      role nbstage.live
      only when $c.commission = "working" and count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) > 0
    idle : text "working"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "working" and count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) = 0
    asks : text "asks JEFF"
      role nbstage.jeff
      only when $c.commission = "waiting" and ($c.waiting_on or "") = ""
    dependency : text "waiting on another task"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "waiting" and ($c.waiting_on or "") != ""
    stuck : text "stuck"
      role nbstage.jeff
      only when $c.commission = "failed"
    ready : text "ready to land"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "ready"
    landing : text "landing"
      role nbstage
      only when $c.commission = "landing"
    usage : text "$c.usage_state"
      role nbstage
      only when ($c.usage_state or "") != ""
    since : text "$(day-or-time($changed.commission, $today))"
      role nbwhen
      only when ($changed.commission or "") != ""
  body : column
    role nbbody
    steps : row
      role nbsteps
      q : text "queued"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission != "asked"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "asked"
      w : text "working"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission = "ready" or $c.commission = "landing"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "working"
        role nbstep.jeff when $c.commission = "waiting" or $c.commission = "failed"
      r : text "ready"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.done when $c.commission = "landing"
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "ready"
      l : text "landing"
        role nbstep
        role nbstep.on when $c.commission = "landing"
      d : text "landed"
        role nbstep
    who : row
      role nbtop
      codex : text "a Codex builder"
        role nbname.link
        only when $c.worker_provider = "codex"
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      claude : text "a Claude builder"
        role nbname.link
        only when ($c.worker_provider or "") != "codex" and ($c.worker or "") != ""
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      owner : text "$c.owner"
        role nbname.link
        only when ($c.worker or "") = "" and ($c.owner or "") != ""
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
      now : text "at work this moment"
        role nbnow
        only when count(house doing=working resident=$c.worker) > 0
      jeff : text "· asked by JEFF"
        role nbwhen
        only when $c.asked_by = "jeff"
      for : text "· asked by $(($c.asked_by or "nobody"))"
        role nbwhen
        only when $c.asked_by != "jeff"
    # now= on a worker's own card: what it is doing this minute, in its own words (lane 3's proposal, a6049 c6262)
    now : text "$c.now"
      role nbnotetext
      clamp 2
      only when ($c.now or "") != ""
    last : column
      of comments:$c.item as m
      each note
    acts : row
      role nbacts
      open : text "Open in the middle"
        role nbbtn
        on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
# the latest comment only (a clamp would print how many it cut, in the card)
note : column
  role nbnote
  only when $index = $count
  by : text "latest, from $m.by"
    role nbnoteby
  said : text "$m.text"
    role nbnotetext
    clamp 3
# the last five landed (by $index, not a clamp, which would print what it cut)
done : row
  role nbdone
  only when $index > $count - 5
  on click do read $hv; do prop $hv viewing=$c back="$hv.viewing" find=""
  what : text "$(($c.brief or $c.title))"
    role nbdonetitle
    clamp 1
    share 1
  when : text "$(day-or-time($changed.commission, $today))"
    role nbwhen
    only when ($changed.commission or "") != ""
